transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. What brings you in today?
I'm here because I've been struggling with episodes where I eat massive amounts of food and just can't seem to stop myself. It's really starting to scare me, and I feel completely out of control.
During these episodes, do you feel like you're eating much more rapidly than normal and continue eating even when uncomfortably full?

Yes, exactly. I eat incredibly fast, and even when my stomach starts to hurt and I feel completely stuffed, I just can't seem to stop myself. It really feels like I have absolutely no control over what I'm doing in those moments.
How often do these episodes happen, and have they been going on for at least three months?
They happen at least once a week, sometimes even more than that. This has actually been going on for about a year and eight months now, so it's been much longer than just three months.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidate was Binge-Eating Disorder, and based on this conversation, the diagnosis remains consistent. The patient reports recurrent episodes of eating significantly more than normal in a discrete period, loss of control during the episodes, eating rapidly, continuing until uncomfortably full, and occurrence at least once per week for more than three months (in this case, over a year). No compensatory behaviors or other symptoms suggesting alternative diagnoses have been mentioned. Therefore, the candidate list remains unchanged.
